risk_tier: T2_semantic with T3 boundary for any game/save write, runtime injection or protected integration
objective: Reverse/discover the game-computed per-game, Advanced, Per Game, Game Log, shot-zone and relevant team metrics in PC NBA2K22 and extend the existing WorldData v24 read-only unified capture system with reproducible source evidence, using internal evidence-driven development Loop.
base_selection: Existing WorldData v24 code is NOT in NBA master. Fork specifically from its frozen candidate 17ec1...; never represent as merged or independently accepted. Read other Stage02 and review from exact SHAs, don't cherry-pick their tree.

sources.finding: 6/6 targeted findings closed; not Native/game/production acceptance

sources.baseline: 100 STRICT tables, 1775 columns, 20 Reader families, frozen regular season candidate; not final complete-world acceptance

human_decisions: VAE Stage02 M1-M5 may be consumed as a semantic requirements baseline after targeted rereview, but not as Native gameplay proof or automatic-tuning authorization.
Native game-computed stats and genuine player-card game-log / advanced fields must be searched first; only after substantiated game absence consider a distinct estimated derivative.
Reuse existing WorldData single-save capture and refresh; no parallel DB, no independent collector framework, no rebuilding cumulative game statistics.
Develop via bounded implement-test-analyze-fix-checkpoint Loop; separate independent review at coherent series milestone unless needed before a load-bearing interface or risky boundary.
Current task focuses native-first data discovery and read-only data engineering, not active VAE settings changes, live match control or optimizer deployment.
full_inventory: All 38 Stage02 metric IDs must receive explicit disposition; not all must be implemented if game source is absent/unverified. Prioritize verified high-value, same-grain fields.
prohibitions: No running-game settings or player/coach/rotation modification; no gameplay or season advancement.
No save-file edits, overwrite of original v24 database, reclassification of materialized old fixture values as Native.
No Frida injection, native mutator/getter calling with uncertain side effects, patching PE, DLL injection, or elevated process action outside current separate authorization.
No new standalone collection pipeline or replacement of existing WorldData and D1-D5 architecture.
No fabricated UI labels, per-game attribution, player IDs, field versions, unit conversions, or collected advanced metrics.
No hidden private attributes/Player Potential in public player card or role exports.
No unrelated lifecycle feature expansion, season capacity tuning, auto gameplay adjustment, master writes, rebases, force pushes, or protected merge.

access_boundary.allow_readonly_game_process_for_user_des: only when current process/save binding and existing Human access conditions are independently confirmed; stop at privilege/injection boundary
access_boundary.external_relay: Human mediated where independent model needed

required_deliverables: Corresponding minimum Reader/codec/refresh/query/test changes inside existing world_data_prototype

cycle: inspect game UI/native source or existing Reader
execute original value consistency and negative tests
diagnose/fix failures or explicitly classify unavailable source
checkpoint exact SHA, logs, before/after evidence, next hypothesis
iterative_process.stop_when: bounded objective achieved or no further lawful evidence-producing increment; report residuals without claiming verified coverage

acceptance_pilot: At least one identified per-game source and one identified genuinely advanced game-native metric should have real read-only capture + stable player/game/season identity + refresh/query round-trip, if available in the designated test environment; if impossible, deliver truthful partial candidate and bounded blocker instead of success.
master_integration: Human decision and separate review required
independent_review: series combined review unless authoritative interface/risky boundary earlier
